camp: 4 Comfort Tents (1 Queen + 1 Single), 5 Deluxe Tents (1 King, or Twin, or 1 King+1 Single, or 2 King), 5 Premium Tents (1 King + 1 Single)

childPolicy.raw: 6-11 years: 50% of adult sharing rate. Under 6: free. Free baby cot subject to availability.

tourLeaderRate.raw: 50% of normal rate, applies only if group exceeds 4 pax.

includes: Accommodation and all meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
Drinking water for all meals and in the tent
excludes: Park fees Jan-Jun: US$100/non-resident adult/day (12hrs), US$50/child (9-17 or students)/day (<9yrs free)
Park fees Jul-Dec: US$200/non-resident adult/day (12hrs), US$50/child (9-17 or students)/day (<9yrs free)
Flights and transfers to/from the camp
Game drives with safari vehicle and driver-guide

extras.item: Safari Landcruiser exclusive use, Masai Mara, Full Day (driver-guide+fuel, no mileage limit)
Safari Landcruiser exclusive use, Masai Mara, Half Day
Safari Landcruiser exclusive use, whole Kenya, Full Day
Transfer from/to Olkiombo Airstrip, one way
Transfer from/to Nairobi, one way, up to 4 pax
Transfer from/to Nairobi, return, up to 4 pax
Birthday/Honeymoon/Celebration Package (1 bottle wine, cake, decoration)
Hot Air Balloon Safari (incl. champagne breakfast)

policies.deposit: 30% deposit required to confirm booking; balance payable 4 weeks prior to arrival. Confirmation voucher issued only after full payment.
policies.cardPaymentSurcharge: 2.5% bank charge added for card payments including online link payments
policies.cancellation: >91 days: no charge; 90-41 days: 30%; 40-21 days: 50%; within 20 days: 100%
